skill.name: customer-support
skill.description: Creates customer support responses, workflows, knowledge content, escalation plans, and service improvement frameworks.
skill.summary: Plan clear, empathetic, and measurable customer support experiences across common service channels.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Support teams need consistent responses and workflows across channels. This skill creates practical replies, guides, escalation plans, and measurement frameworks for customer service operations.
actual_capabilities: Drafts empathetic customer replies with clear next steps and follow-up questions.
Designs chatbot conversations, ticket routing rules, SLA workflows, and escalation paths.
Creates FAQ outlines, knowledge base plans, and structured troubleshooting guides.
Plans consistent support across email, chat, social, phone, and messaging channels.
Recommends CSAT, NPS, effort, resolution, and agent performance measurement approaches.
Develops support plans for e-commerce, incidents, team training, and service growth.
limitations: The skill provides guidance and templates but does not operate support platforms or execute integrations.
It cannot access customer records, ticket history, or channel data unless the user provides them.
Recommendations require validation against company policies, privacy rules, and regulatory requirements.
The referenced implementation playbook is not included in the published skill files.

use_cases.title: Standardize Support Workflows
use_cases.description: Define routing, priorities, SLA targets, escalation paths, and quality checks for a growing support team.

use_cases.title: Resolve Customer Issues
use_cases.description: Prepare clear replies, troubleshooting steps, and handoff notes for complex customer conversations.

use_cases.title: Improve Commerce Support
use_cases.description: Plan consistent handling for order status, shipping delays, returns, refunds, billing, and product questions.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Customer Reply
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft an empathetic reply to this customer issue: [issue]. Include a clear next step and ask one useful follow-up question.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a focused response for one customer request.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Troubleshooting Guide
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a troubleshooting guide for [problem]. Order checks from simple to advanced, define escalation criteria, and include a resolution confirmation step.
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn a recurring issue into reusable agent guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Design Ticket Routing
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a ticket routing workflow for [channels and products]. Define categories, priority rules, ownership, SLA targets, escalation paths, and reporting metrics.
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinate ticket handling across teams and service levels.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Omnichannel Improvement
prompt_templates.prompt: Develop an omnichannel support plan using [data]. Identify friction, automation opportunities, privacy controls, handoffs, experiments, and measurable success criteria.
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve a mature support operation using customer and performance evidence.

output_examples.input: Reply to a customer whose order arrived one day late.
output_examples.output: I understand the delay is frustrating. I will check the carrier status now and send you an update today.

output_examples.input: Create an escalation outline for repeated payment failures.
output: Priority: High when multiple customers report the same payment failure.
Owner: Billing support reviews account details and confirms the payment provider status.
Escalation: Notify engineering when logs indicate a shared technical failure.
Closure: Confirm payment success and document the cause before resolving the ticket.

output_examples.input: Outline a help article for password reset problems.
output: Confirm the account email and check for typing errors.
Review spam folders and approved sender settings.
Request a new reset link and use only the latest message.
Escalate after identity verification if delivery continues to fail.

best_practices: Provide the customer context, desired outcome, channel, policies, and available actions.
Review every recommendation against current product behavior and support authority.
Measure outcomes with resolution time, customer effort, satisfaction, and repeat contact rates.
anti_patterns: Do not include passwords, payment details, access tokens, or unnecessary personal information.
Do not promise refunds, credits, deadlines, or technical fixes without confirmed authority.
Do not automate sensitive decisions without human review and a documented escalation path.

faq.question: Can this skill answer customer tickets?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the issue, relevant policy, available actions, and preferred tone for a tailored draft.

faq.question: Does it connect directly to help desk software?
faq.answer: No. It can plan integrations and workflows, but it does not access or operate external systems.

faq.question: Can it create a knowledge base?
faq.answer: It can produce article outlines, FAQ structures, troubleshooting flows, maintenance plans, and search improvement recommendations.

faq.question: Does it support multiple channels?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers email, chat, social, phone, messaging, and channel handoff planning.

faq.question: Can it evaluate support performance?
faq.answer: It can recommend metrics, reporting structures, review criteria, and experiments when you provide suitable operational data.

faq.question: How should sensitive customer data be handled?
faq.answer: Remove unnecessary personal data and secrets. Follow company privacy, retention, access, and compliance policies.
